decision_rationale: CellWhisperer is presented as a new chat model trained on single-cell/bulk transcriptomes with Mistral, not as a review or wrapper. The provided methods text shows explicit transcriptome-to-LLM token mapping and answer generation from question-answer conversations.
evidence_snippet: "CellWhisperer chat model"; "transcriptome-derived token embeddings alongside their corresponding questions"; "optimized the LLM and the transcriptome-token adapter to generate the corresponding answers"
